questions.question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution enforces that it is the duty of the State to apply directive principles in making laws?

questions.question: What are ribosomes made up of?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Proteins and RNA**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ribosomes are made up of both proteins and RNA**
 
• These** two components combine to form two subunits – a large subunit and a small subunit **– which together make a functional ribosome.
 
• Ribosomal **RNA plays a crucial role in the ribosome's structure and function.**
 
• It **helps in catalyzing the formation of peptide bonds, acting as a ribozyme,** which is essential for protein synthesis.
 
• **Ribosomal proteins provide structural support **and aid in the proper folding of rRNA.
 
• They also assist in assembling the ribosomal subunits and facilitating their interaction with messenger RNA (mRNA) and transfer RNA (tRNA) during protein synthesis.
 
• Ribosomes are the **site of protein synthesis** in the cell.

questions.question: A completes a piece of work in 4 days and B completes it in 6 days. How long will it take to complete the same piece of work if they both work together?

**Given:**

A's time to complete the work alone = 4 days.

B's time to complete the work alone = 6 days.

**Formula Used:**

Combined work rate = 1 / (1/A's time + 1/B's time)

**Calculation:**

Work rate of A = 1/4

Work rate of B = 1/6

Combined work rate = 1/4 + 1/6

Combined work rate = (1)/(4) + (1)/(6)

⇒ Combined work rate = (3)/(12) + (2)/(12)

⇒ Combined work rate = (5)/(12)

Time taken to complete the work together = 1 / Combined work rate

Time taken to complete the work together = (12)/(5) days

Time taken to complete the work together = 2 ²/₅ days

**The time taken to complete the work if A and B work together is 2 ²/₅ days.**
